query: My tablet screen stays completely blank when I try to use Data Transfer to scan the QR code for transferring data from my Nexa X1 phone, so the transfer can't proceed.

contexts.goal: Follow these steps to perform this Secure Folder Transfer Troubleshooting
contexts.title: Secure folder transfer

steps: Wireless connection: If you are using a wireless transfer, place the devices within 4 inches of each other.
Wired connection: If you are using a wired transfer, plug one end of the USB cable into the charging port of the new phone.
Connect the other end to the charging port of the old phone.

actions.description: It will open data transfer app

steps: Swipe up on the Home screen to access the Apps screen.
Enter and select Data Transfer to open the app.
Alternatively, navigate to the TechCorp folder on the Apps screen.
On the new device, tap Receive on this phone.
On the old device, tap Send from this phone.
Wireless transfer: On the new device, tap Nexa/Android.
On the old device, tap Wireless data transfer.
Scan QR code displayed on new phone.
